## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix mixed-case writes so the new `Cache.set` method preserves case-insensitive lookups.

## Changes

The pull request adds `Cache.set`, raises the default TTL from 60 to 300 seconds, and adds tests for round trips, the default TTL, and expiry.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- app/cache.py:27 — correctness — Lowercase keys before storing entries — After `set("ALPHA", 1)`, both `get("ALPHA")` and `get("alpha")` return `None` on a fresh cache. `set` stores `"ALPHA"` verbatim, while `get` looks up `"alpha"`. — Mixed-case writes produce cache misses and leave entries that lookup-driven expiry cannot remove. — Fix: Store entries under `key.lower()` and extend `test_set_then_get_round_trip` to write a mixed-case key.
